Proposed question: Simplify by factorising each base to the smallest prime factors.
a) $\dfrac{(6^{n+1})^{n}}{(3^{n})^{n+1}}$
b) $\dfrac{(6^{n})^{n+1}\times(4^{n})^{2}}{(2^{n+1})^{n}\times(9^{n})^{n-1}}$
Answers: a) $2^{n^2+n}$; b) $2^{4n}\times3^{-n^2+3n}$
